item.title: Merenguando en Familia Winter Break Family Day: Fiesta, Latin Traditions & Dominican Culture
item.description: For families who want a mid-winter break activity that’s meaningful, joyful, and full of cultural expression, Merenguando en Familia ticks every box. At a Glance: All ages welcome! item.title: Jericho School District celebrates Diversity Day with a range of student performances
item.description: Jericho Middle School celebrated its annual Diversity Day on Friday, Feb. 6, with roughly 110 students participating in the event. Organized by the Jericho United Club, the annual Diversity Day celebration features performances highlighting the diverse cultural backgrounds, nationalities, and talents of its student body. item.title: ‘Lighting the darkness’ with Mineola’s new players
item.description: Mineola’s theater scene has a new player: Mezzo Theatrical. The family-run production company is beginning to rehearse “Almost, Maine,” its inaugural play in a new location, which will open May 1. Co-founders and spouses Cathryn and John Mezzo said they have high hopes for the Mineola theater, and are looking to the future for cooperation... Read More

item.title: Massapequa man gets 15 years for illegal weapons possession, impersonating officer
item.description: A Massapequa man was sentenced on Tuesday, Feb. 10, to 15 years in prison after being convicted of multiple counts of weapons possession and impersonating a police officer, Nassau County District Attorney Anne Donnelly announced. item.description: A Deer Park man was indicted on Tuesday, Feb. 10, for allegedly taking over a bank account held by the Chabad of Roslyn and initiating nearly 350 unauthorized debit transactions and other check fraud for a total theft in excess of $157,000, Nassau County District Attorney Anne Donnelly announced. item.description: A Brooklyn man was arrested on Tuesday, Feb. 10, for the acid attack on a then-Hofstra student in Elmont five years ago that led to several medical procedures, according to Nassau County Police. item.title: Umberto’s will take over former Frank’s Steaks location on Jericho Turnpike
item.description: Umberto’s of Oyster Bay, a well-known pizza shop on Main Street, is preparing to expand its operations by moving into the former Frank’s Steaks location on Jericho Turnpike in Westbury, which shuttered in 2024 after 35 years in business. item.description: The North Hempstead Town Board voted to limit an area of the Port Washington Public Parking District to be used only by Long Island Railroad commuters at its Tuesday, Feb. 10 meeting.
